result_revision.change_summary: Initial maintainer-local schema-v3 replay of the retained AoA 22 GeoTransolver result (epoch 1000).

model: GeoTransolver surface and volume, AoA 22, epoch 1000

methodology.record_note: Candidate mechanics replay from the retained AoA 22 resolved training configurations, raw loaded checkpoint hashes, training logs, and complete native-support Slurm inference. Training timing uses conservative retained calendar envelopes; inference timing uses the recorded campaign allocation ledger. This local record is not an accepted submission.

architecture.description: Two independently trained PhysicsNeMo GeoTransolver models: one predicts nine native surface channels and one predicts six native flow-domain channels. Both use 12 transformer blocks, configured hidden width 256, eight attention heads, MLP ratio four, 256 slices, and a three-scale local-feature branch with width 32 per scale (352 effective hidden width).

components.description: Geometry-aware six-functional-input, three-geometry-input, three-global-input, nine-output GeoTransolver for native surface points.
Geometry-aware seven-functional-input, three-geometry-input, three-global-input, six-output GeoTransolver for retained valid native flow-domain points.

key_hyperparameters.name: Multi-scale local feature branch
key_hyperparameters.description: Three local neighborhoods are embedded independently and appended to the configured 256-wide transformer state.

key_hyperparameters.name: Training sampling resolution
key_hyperparameters.description: Maximum sampled native points per case during training.

input_features.name: Surface coordinates and normals
input_features.description: Three native point coordinates and three vehicle surface-normal components.

input_features.name: Freestream velocity
input_features.description: The case freestream velocity expanded at queried surface points.

input_features.name: Volume coordinates, signed distance, and signed-distance normals
input_features.description: Three native point coordinates, scalar signed distance, and three signed-distance-normal components.

input_features.name: Freestream velocity
input_features.description: The case freestream velocity expanded at queried volume points.

predicted_fields.description: Surface pressure is a direct output channel.
The three wall-shear-stress components are direct output channels.
The three nondimensional velocity components are direct output channels.
Nondimensional flow-domain pressure is a direct output channel.

data_handling.normalization: Dataset transforms nondimensionalize fields from case metadata; fixed training-set channel centering/scaling is applied by the retained training pipeline. Inference reverses model normalization before scoring nondimensional pressure, wall shear, and velocity.
data_handling.preprocessing: Surface inputs use native coordinates and vehicle normals. Volume inputs are centered native coordinates augmented with signed distance and signed-distance normals; the freestream vector is expanded per query.
data_handling.sampling: Training samples at most 200000 native points per case. AoA 22 inference deterministically traverses every retained native support point in bounded chunks and scores immediately without retaining dense prediction fields.

stages.description: From-scratch distributed training on the official AoA 22 surface training split. Retained logs cover 1000 complete epochs.

loss.description: Huber loss over predicted surface fields.
loss.weighting: pressure=2.0, temperature=0.25, density=0.5, velocity=0.5, wall shear=1.0
